title: Indigenous San Luis Potosí: The Land of the... — Indigenous Mexico
text: The Pames were a semi-nomadic tribe, constituting a very divergent branch of the Otomanguean linguistic family. They were located mainly in the southeastern part of San Luis Potosi south and east of the Río Verde and also in adjoining areas of Tamaulipas, Querétaro and Guanajuato.
